subject: building_construction
distractorPoolRule: Each item draws choices only from its own property and unit family: g/cm³ density values, N/mm² strength/allowable-stress values, N/mm² Young's-modulus values, or /K linear-thermal-expansion values. Strength/allowable-stress and Young's-modulus values never share an answer pool. Every thermal-expansion item declares its source-year convention; steel values from different years never share an answer pool. No structural-mechanics values.

questions.prompt:
木材（スギ）の基準強度（圧縮）として最も適切な値を選びなさい。

（2.4, 24, 240, 2,400）N/mm²
